scientific_frame.question: Can Merlin extract bounded auditable low-level features from explicitly submitted sensor media and provide consistent synthetic associations without leaking raw media or inventing semantic claims?
scientific_frame.baseline: No current sensory analysis API, only optional approved screenshot
falsifiers: unexpected remote transfer or storage of raw captures
semantic recognition claimed from pixel statistics
same fixed feature yields inconsistent cue
biases: proxy metric substituted for vision understanding
successful hash check mistaken for measurement accuracy
scientific_frame.independent_check: compare against separately measured synthetic image/audio references and inspect actual browser network/storage on target host

simplex.reason: No calibrated mixture of sensory streams; weighted fusion would require normalized weights and reliability measurement

n_ality.test: No collapse of media identity, measurement or authority into one scalar

continuum.reason: Physical time-aligned audiovisual streams need explicit sample clocks, interpolation error and boundary conditions

fuzzy.reason: Cue salience may be graded, but authorization/integrity tests remain Boolean
